Larsen & Toubro Secures (Large*) Order 
for Deploying AI Cluster  
 
LTN Compute to deploy additional NVIDIA B300 GPUs at its Chennai campus to power an 
inference infrastructure provider’s AI-native platform as part of the 10,000 GPU cluster 
Mumbai, November 23, 2026: The L&T Group company, Vyoma.AI, through its AI 
infrastructure subsidiary LTN Compute, has secured a multi-year engagement with an 
inference infrastructure provider for the deployment of an additional NVIDIA B300 GPUs at 
its Chennai Data Center. 
The infrastructure will power the inference infrastructure provider’s AI-native platform, 
enabling it to train, fine-tune and deploy specialised AI models for high-performance 
inference at commercial scale. This development strengthens India’s AI infrastructure while 
supporting growing global demand for advanced compute. 
The integrated AI Factory will bring together hyperscale data center infrastructure, 
accelerated computing, high-performance networking, ultra-low-latency interconnects, 
high-throughput parallel storage and comprehensive AI infrastructure operations to enable 
efficient deployment of demanding AI workloads.  
The AI Factory is being developed at Vyoma.AI’s Chennai campus, envisioned as a gigawatt-
scale AI infrastructure hub. Its Phase 1 is designed for 250 MW, supported by 150 MVA power 
infrastructure readiness, providing a scalable foundation for future capacity expansion. 
“Artificial Intelligence is transforming industries, and AI Factories will provide the 
foundational infrastructure to power this transformation. This additional GPU deployment 
marks another significant milestone in L&T’s vision to build world-class AI infrastructure in 
India. Our Chennai AI Factory will deliver the scale, performance and resilience required to 
accelerate global AI innovation and strengthen India’s position as a leading hub for next-
generation computing”, said Mr S N Subrahmanyan, Chairman & Managing Director, Larsen 
& Toubro. 
LTN Compute is building next generation AI-ready digital infrastructure across India through 
hyperscale AI data centers, sovereign cloud platforms, AI Factory services, Bare Metal-as-a-
Service (BMaaS), GPU-as-a-Service (GPUaaS) and managed AI platforms to support 
governments, enterprises, cloud providers and AI innovators.

SWREL bagged three domestic orders including L1 position for a marquee 
project with a combined value of more than INR 2050 crore 
 
~ Receives 600 MWh BESS turnkey project order from a leading PSU in Gujarat 
~ Secures 350 MW Solar projects, which includes L1 position for a turnkey solar project from a 
leading PSU  
 
Mumbai; November 23, 2026: Sterling and Wilson Renewable Energy Limited (SWREL) (BSE Scrip Code: 
542760; NSE Symbol: SWSOLAR), a leading renewable EPC has announced three marquee domestic orders 
– a 600 MWh BESS turnkey project in Gujarat awarded by a leading PSU and a solar project from a Private 
IPP in Rajasthan. The company has also recently emerged L1 for a prestigious solar turnkey project in 
Madhya Pradesh. The total value of all the projects is more than INR 2050 crore.  
 
Speaking on the new developments, Mr. Chandra Kishore Thakur, Global CEO, Sterling and Wilson 
Renewable Energy said, “We are honored and privileged to have received two significant orders and for 
being selected as an L1 bidder for a prestigious project in India. These orders mark another noteworthy 
milestone in SWREL’s growing renewable project portfolio and reinforces our position as a competitive, 
trusted reliable EPC player in India’s rapidly expanding renewable sector. We look forward to supporting our 
customer’s long-term growth, exceeding their expectations, and delivering meaningful impact as we build 
on this momentum." 
 
About Sterling and Wilson Renewable Energy Limited 
Sterling and Wilson Renewable Energy Limited (SWREL) is a global pure-play, end-to-end renewable 
engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) solutions provider. The company provides EPC services 
for utility-scale solar, floating solar, hybrid & energy storage and wind solutions and has a total portfolio of 
over 29.8 GWp (including projects commissioned and under various stages of construction). SWREL also 
manages an operation and maintenance (O&M) portfolio of 18.9 GWp solar power projects, including for 
projects constructed by third parties. Present in 28 countries today, Sterling and Wilson Renewable Energy 
Limited has operations in India, South-east Asia, Middle East, Africa, Europe, Australia, and the Americas. 
Visit us – www.sterlingandwilsonre.com   
LinkedIn – https://www.linkedin.com/company/sterling-and-wilson-renewable-energy/

customer’s long-term growth, exceeding their expectations, and delivering meaningful impact as we build

Titagarh Rail Systems bags new order from JSW for 181 BFNSM1 wagons and 3 BVCM wagons. 
Gets approval to manufacture auto carrier wagons expanding its product offering 
 
Kolkata, 23 November, 2026: Titagarh Rail Systems Limited has further strengthened its position in the freight 
wagon industry by bagging an order from JSW(South) Rail Logistics Pvt Ltd. for INR. 77.09 crs.  
In addition, it received route clearance from Indian railways to manufacture and despatch specialised auto carrier 
wagons which enable Titagarh to become one of the few wagon manufacturers to have the capability of 
producing all kind of Freight wagons from pressurised tank wagons to carry gas and petroleum products to 
carrying all kind of automobiles.  
The approval from the railway authorities for the operation and movement of auto carrier wagons connects its 
Bharatpur Manufacturing Unit to the Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited (DFCCIL) network.  
Automobile movement on rail has caught momentum recently and the market of auto carriers has been very 
buoyant over the last few months. In absence of this approval, Titagarh was unable to address this growing 
market segment in absence of this approval which Titagarh plans to get very actively engaged in doing based on 
the approval. Titagarh has also started taking steps to manufacture a prototype wagon for these auto carriers in 
order to offer shorter delivery timelines to the customers. 
Commenting on the development, Shri Umesh Chowdhary, Vice Chairman & Managing Director, Titagarh Rail 
Systems Limited, said: 
“The introduction of ACT wagons into our freight rolling stock portfolio marks another significant step towards 
broadening our product offerings and strengthening our capabilities in specialised freight solutions. With the 
approval for movement from our Bharatpur Manufacturing Unit to the DFCCIL network now in place, we are 
better positioned to enhance our manufacturing and delivery capabilities and contribute more meaningfully to 
the DFC network. We believe this will further strengthen the freight rail ecosystem, support greater efficiency in 
freight movement and contribute towards the national target of achieving 3,000 MT freight loading by 2027. 
This development also reinforces our commitment to the vision of Make in India and Aatmanirbhar Bharat. We 
remain committed to supporting the Government’s vision through the development and delivery of innovative, 
reliable and indigenously manufactured rolling stock solutions that contribute to the continued growth and 
modernisation of India’s railway and freight infrastructure.” 
About Titagarh Rail Systems Limited 
Titagarh Rail Systems is a leading comprehensive mobility solution provider with a strong presence in India. With 
state-of-the-art factories in the country, we are committed to meeting the diverse requirements of passenger 
and freight rolling stock. At Titagarh, we specialize in crafting cutting-edge transportation solutions, including 
semi high-speed trains, urban metros, passenger coaches, propulsion systems, and a wide array of wagons, 
including specialized ones. With a passion for innovation and an unwavering dedication to excellence, our 
commitment lies in shaping the future of transportation, embodying the spirit of Make in India and contributing 
towards a Viksit Bharat. We strive to deliver world-class products that redefine the way people and goods move 
across the world. Explore our diverse range of products and experience the future of transportation at 
www.titagarh.in

PRESS RELEASE
PTC Industries Secures Major Indian Defence
Order for 400 Tonnes of Titanium Products,
Strengthening India's Defence Self-Reliance
Lucknow, India – 23 November 2026 – PTC Industries Limited, a leading Indian manufacturer of advanced materials and
high-performance engineering components, has secured a contract from the Indian Defence Sector for the supply of
approximately 400 tonnes of Titanium ingots, bars and rods.
The contract represents a significant addition to the Company’s defence order book and reinforces its position as a
domestic supplier of strategically important Titanium products for critical defence applications. The materials supplied
under the contract are intended to support defence systems requiring high strength, corrosion resistance, dimensional
stability and long-term operational reliability under demanding service conditions.
Titanium is recognised as a strategic engineering material across the defence, aerospace, marine and nuclear sectors
owing to its exceptional mechanical properties, low density and superior resistance to corrosion. Establishing indigenous
manufacturing capabilities for such critical materials is fundamental to strengthening India’s strategic supply-chain
resilience and reducing dependence on imports for advanced defence applications.
The order is aligned with the Government of India’s ongoing efforts to promote indigenous manufacturing under the
Atmanirbhar Bharat initiative and supports the broader objective of increasing domestic value addition in defence
production. By expanding the indigenous availability of high-performance Titanium products, the contract contributes to
the development of a robust domestic ecosystem for strategic materials and advanced manufacturing technologies.
PTC Industries, through its wholly owned subsidiary Aerolloy Technologies Limited, has made significant investments in
developing advanced Titanium and Superalloy manufacturing capabilities in India. These investments encompass
specialised alloy melting and ingot production, forging, the development of mill products, precision casting, inspection
and testing, supported by advanced metallurgical expertise and quality assurance systems. By progressively integrating
critical stages of the manufacturing value chain, the Group is building greater control over material quality, traceability,
manufacturing processes and supply reliability. These capabilities are aimed at meeting the stringent requirements of
defence and aerospace applications and strengthening India’s indigenous advanced materials manufacturing base.
Beyond its commercial significance, the contract is expected to contribute to India’s advanced manufacturing ecosystem
by supporting technology development, expanding specialised industrial capabilities, creating opportunities for skilled
employment and strengthening domestic supply chains for critical materials. Such initiatives are integral to achieving
greater self-reliance in strategic manufacturing while enhancing the global competitiveness of India’s defence industry.
The contract also reflects the increasing participation of Indian industry in developing an indigenous defence
manufacturing base and underscores the importance of sustained collaboration between the armed forces and
domestic manufacturers in advancing national capabilities across strategically important sectors.
PTC INDUSTRIES LIMITED · CIN L27109UP1963PLC002931
Tel: +91 522 7111017 · Fax: +91 522 2265302 · Email: info@ptcil.com · www.ptcil.com Page 1 of 2

Chairman and Managing Director’s Statement
Mr. Sachin Agarwal, Chairman & Managing Director, PTC Industries Limited, said:
“We are grateful for the confidence placed in PTC Industries through this order. Supplying approximately 400 tonnes
of Titanium ingots, bars and rods for India’s defence requirements is a strong validation of the integrated materials
capability that we have been building over several years – from alloy melting and ingot production to forging and
mill products.
Titanium sits at the very foundation of modern defence and aerospace systems, and the ability to produce it reliably at
scale is a measure of strategic independence. This order demonstrates that PTC ONE™ – From Melt to Mission™ is
now delivering at meaningful volumes, and that critical materials India has long sourced from abroad can be produced
here, to the most exacting standards. We will continue to invest with patience and purpose in capabilities that help
India stand at par with the world.”
Advanced Manufacturing & Technology Centre (AMTC), Lucknow
ABOUT PTC INDUSTRIES LIMITED
PTC Industries Limited is an Indian advanced manufacturing company specialising in critical materials, high-integrity
precision castings and complex engineering components for aerospace, defence, space, energy and other technology-
intensive industries.
Through its wholly owned subsidiary, Aerolloy Technologies Limited, the Group is developing an integrated manufacturing
platform for Titanium and Superalloy materials, including advanced alloy melting, ingot production, forging, rolling and mill
products, alongside precision investment castings, special processes and high-precision machining capabilities.
Guided by its PTC ONE™ — From Melt to Mission™ strategy, the Group is focused on bringing together advanced materials,
metallurgy and manufacturing technologies within an integrated industrial system. Its long-term objective is to establish
globally competitive capabilities in critical materials and mission-critical components, supporting India’s strategic self-reliance
while serving the requirements of international aerospace, defence, space and energy industries.

Strengthening India's Defence Self-Reliance
Lucknow, India – 23 November 2026 – PTC Industries Limited, a leading Indian manufacturer of advanced materials and
high-performance engineering components, has secured a contract from the Indian Defence Sector for the supply of
approximately 400 tonnes of Titanium ingots, bars and rods.
The contract represents a significant addition to the Company’s defence order book and reinforces its position as a
domestic supplier of strategically important Titanium products for critical defence applications. The materials supplied
under the contract are intended to support defence systems requiring high strength, corrosion resistance, dimensional
stability and long-term operational reliability under demanding service conditions.
Titanium is recognised as a strategic engineering material across the defence, aerospace, marine and nuclear sectors
owing to its exceptional mechanical properties, low density and superior resistance to corrosion. Establishing indigenous
manufacturing capabilities for such critical materials is fundamental to strengthening India’s strategic supply-chain
resilience and reducing dependence on imports for advanced defence applications.
The order is aligned with the Government of India’s ongoing efforts to promote indigenous manufacturing under the
Atmanirbhar Bharat initiative and supports the broader objective of increasing domestic value addition in defence
production. By expanding the indigenous availability of high-performance Titanium products, the contract contributes to
the development of a robust domestic ecosystem for strategic materials and advanced manufacturing technologies.
PTC Industries, through its wholly owned subsidiary Aerolloy Technologies Limited, has made significant investments in
developing advanced Titanium and Superalloy manufacturing capabilities in India. These investments encompass
specialised alloy melting and ingot production, forging, the development of mill products, precision casting, inspection
and testing, supported by advanced metallurgical expertise and quality assurance systems. By progressively integrating
critical stages of the manufacturing value chain, the Group is building greater control over material quality, traceability,
manufacturing processes and supply reliability. These capabilities are aimed at meeting the stringent requirements of
defence and aerospace applications and strengthening India’s indigenous advanced materials manufacturing base.
Beyond its commercial significance, the contract is expected to contribute to India’s advanced manufacturing ecosystem
by supporting technology development, expanding specialised industrial capabilities, creating opportunities for skilled
employment and strengthening domestic supply chains for critical materials. Such initiatives are integral to achieving
greater self-reliance in strategic manufacturing while enhancing the global competitiveness of India’s defence industry.
The contract also reflects the increasing participation of Indian industry in developing an indigenous defence
manufacturing base and underscores the importance of sustained collaboration between the armed forces and
domestic manufacturers in advancing national capabilities across strategically important sectors.

ARKADE STRENGTHENS ITS SOUTH MUMBAI FOOTPRINT WITH LANDMARK 
REDEVELOPMENT TARGETING ~1500 Cr GDV IN TARDEO 
 
~2-acre redevelopment project with a projected Gross Development Value (GDV) of ₹1,500 
crore reinforces Arkade’s growth ambitions in one of Mumbai’s most prestigious real estate 
markets. 
Mumbai, 23rd November 2026: Arkade Developers, leading luxury listed real estate 
developers in Mumbai, has announced its strategic re-entry into the coveted South Mumbai 
(SoBo) real estate market with an ambitious redevelopment project in Tardeo, marking a 
significant milestone in the company's growth journey. Building on its existing presence in 
Mazagaon, Altamount Road and Carmichael Road, Arkade is further expanding its footprint 
across South Mumbai’s premium residential landscape. 
The redevelopment project is spread across approximately 2 acres and is expected to have a 
projected Gross Development Value (GDV) of ₹1,500 crore, as a significant addition to 
Arkade’s redevelopment portfolio. The project underscores the company’s confidence in the 
long-term potential of South Mumbai and its commitment to identifying high-value 
redevelopment opportunities in established micro-markets across the city. 
Tardeo, renowned for its central location, established social infrastructure, premium 
residential character and excellent connectivity, continues to remain one of Mumbai’s most 
sought-after residential destinations. With limited availability of developable land and 
sustained demand for quality residential spaces, the micro-market presents compelling 
opportunities for thoughtfully conceptualized redevelopment. 
Arkade’s return to South Mumbai represents more than a geographic expansion; it reflects a 
strategic step towards strengthening its presence in Mumbai’s premium real estate 
landscape. Leveraging its experience in residential development and redevelopment, the 
company aims to unlock the potential of well-established urban locations through projects 
that combine contemporary aspirations with the enduring value of prime addresses. 
Speaking on the acquisition, Mr. Amit Jain, CMD of Arkade Developers, said:  
Our re-entry into South Mumbai is an important strategic milestone for Arkade. Tardeo 
represents the very essence of Mumbai's premium residential landscape, offering a rare 
combination of location, legacy and long-term value. This project reflects our confidence in 
the redevelopment potential of established neighborhoods and our ambition to create 
meaningful value in some of Mumbai's most sought-after locations. We see this as the 
beginning of an exciting new chapter in our journey in South Mumbai." 
The Tardeo project further strengthens Arkade’s development pipeline and reflects its broader 
strategy of capitalizing on Mumbai’s evolving urban landscape, particularly through 
redevelopment-led growth. As the city increasingly looks towards revitalizing established 

 
 
 
neighborhoods, Arkade aims to play a meaningful role in shaping the next phase of Mumbai’s 
residential transformation. 
Furthermore, the company is geared up for two significant launches in Q4, Arkade Ascend, 
located in Malad(W) and Arkade Thane, Kasarvadavali,  having a combined projected GDV of 
2800 Cr. 
This acquisition not only strengthens our presence in a key growth corridor but also reinforces 
our ambition to build a future-ready portfolio of landmark developments across the Mumbai 
Metropolitan Region”. 
 
About Arkade Developers Ltd:  
Arkade Developers is a leading luxury real estate developer in Mumbai and is listed on both 
the exchanges, BSE (544261) and NSE (ARKADE). With a rich legacy spanning over 40 years, 
the company has established itself as a symbol of quality and excellence. 
Under the leadership of Chairman and Managing Director Mr. Amit Jain, Arkade Developers 
has transformed into one of Mumbai’s most respected real estate firms. The company has 
completed 33 projects under his vision and created homes for over 5,800 happy families. 
Guided by the core philosophy of "Family First," Arkade Developers focuses on building 
family-friendly homes and upholds values such as trust, transparency, commitment, and 
happiness. Known for its timely project deliveries, Arkade Developers has made a significant 
mark in the Mumbai real estate sector, having developed over 5.8 million square feet of 
property, with an additional 3+ million square feet currently under construction. 
The company's commitment to quality is reflected in its meticulous planning, innovative 
designs, and use of advanced technologies, which ensure that every project is delivered on 
time and to the highest standards. 
 
 
 
 
 
For more information, visit: https://arkade.in/ 
 
 
40+years of legacy | 33 projects completed | 5.8+ M sq. ft. developed | 3+ M sq. ft. 
under development | 5,800+ Happy Families | Listed on BSE & NSE | Pioneers in 
Timely Delivery

Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015, and the applicable SEBI circulars issued thereunder, we wish to inform you that Silver 
Touch Technologies Limited ("the Company") has received a Contract (No. GEMC-511687782323631 dated 
23rd November 2026, against GeM Bid No. GEM/2025/B/6400459) from Gujarat Urja Vikas Nigam Limited 
(GUVNL) for the Design, Supply, Rollout and Maintenance of Microsoft’s Active Directory Solution with 
required software and licenses for GUVNL and its subsidiaries. 
Key particulars of the order are set out below: 
Name of the entity 
awarding the order 
Gujarat Urja Vikas Nigam Limited (GUVNL), Vadodara – Energy and 
Petrochemicals Department, Government of Gujarat, for itself and its six 
subsidiary companies (GSECL, GETCO, UGVCL, MGVCL, DGVCL and PGVCL) 
Significant terms and 
conditions of the order, in 
brief 
Turnkey design, supply, implementation, enterprise rollout and maintenance 
of Microsoft Active Directory solution on GUVNL’s on-premise infrastructure, 
covering supply of perpetual Microsoft Windows Server and Client Access 
Licenses, migration of approximately 18,000 desktops across more than 850 
locations, training and handover, and five years of AMC with on-site certified 
manpower support. Contract awarded through the GeM portal on a 
milestone-based lumpsum basis, with quarterly billing. 
Whether 
order(s)/contract(s) is 
awarded by 
domestic/international 
entity 
Domestic 
Nature of 
order(s)/contract(s) 
Identity and access management infrastructure – supply, implementation, 
migration and managed support services 
Time period for execution 
of the order 
Service period:-  implementation and rollout within 12 months, followed by 
five years of AMC and on-site support from final acceptance 

   
 
Broad consideration or 
size of the order 
₹8,60,00,000 (Rupees Eight Crore Sixty Lakh only), inclusive of all duties and 
taxes 
Whether the 
promoter/promoter 
group/group companies 
have any interest in the 
entity that awarded the 
order(s)/contract(s)? If 
yes, nature of interest 
and details thereof; 
No 
Whether the order falls 
within related party 
transactions; if yes, 
whether the same is done 
at arm's length 
No 
 
Strategic Significance 
The Company has a clear and growing strategic focus on the Energy and Power sector and on critical 
infrastructure management. Power generation, transmission and distribution utilities run some of the 
country’s most essential and sensitive digital environments, where secure identity, access control and 
uninterrupted availability are fundamental to reliable 24x7 power supply. 
This order spans the entire Gujarat state power value chain – generation, transmission and distribution – 
covering approximately 18,000 endpoints across more than 850 locations, including corporate offices, power 
stations and sub-stations. It will establish a centrally managed, policy-driven identity and security backbone 
aligned with the guidelines of CERT-In, NCIIPC and the Ministry of Power. 
The order strengthens the Company’s position as a trusted technology partner to power utilities and critical 
infrastructure operators, brings multi-year recurring revenue visibility through five years of AMC and on-site 
managed support, and opens opportunities for further cybersecurity, infrastructure management and digital 
transformation engagements across the energy sector. 
The above intimation will also be made available on company’s website i.e. https://www.silvertouch.com  
Kindly take the above intimation on the record.     
Thanking you, 
 
 
Yours Faithfully, 
 
 
FOR SILVER TOUCH TECHNOLOGIES LIMITED 
 
 
RAHUL ADVANI 
COMPANY SECRETARY & COMPLIANCE OFFICER

Dear Sir/Madam,
We refer to our earlier intimation dated July 8, 2026, wherein we had informed about the approval
of the Scheme of Arrangement (Merger by Absorption) (“Scheme”) of Kalpataru Hills Residency
Private Limited (“Transferor Company”), a step-down wholly-owned subsidiary with Kalpataru
Properties (Thane) Limited (“Transferee Company”), a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company
and their respective shareholders (“the Scheme”), by the respective Board of Directors of the
Transferor Company and the Transferee Company. In this regard, we wish to further inform that,
Regional Director, Western Region-I vide his Order (“RD Order”) dated November 18, 2026
(attached herewith as “Annexure A”) has approved the Scheme under Section 233 of the
Companies Act, 2013.
The RD Order sanctioning the Scheme was filed by the respective companies with the Registrar of
Companies, Mumbai-I (“ROC”) on November 23, 2026, on which date the Scheme became
effective. Consequently, the Transferor Company stands dissolved and ceases to be a step-down
subsidiary of the Company.
The Company has received information from both the Companies about the filing of respective
forms with ROC, on November 23, 2026 at 06:40 p.m.

https://www.kalpataru.com/investor-corner.

For Kalpataru Limited

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE 
RMC Switchgears receives Letter of Intent for an estimated ₹521.84 crore turnkey distribution-
infrastructure package in Maharashtra  
 
The proposed work package covers substations, transformers, HT lines and allied infrastructure 
under an ADB-funded programme 
 
Jaipur, 24 November 2026: RMC Switchgears Limited (NSE: RMC; BSE: 540358), a power 
infrastructure, engineering and EPC solutions company, has received a Letter of Intent for the 
development of distribution infrastructure and system strengthening works, covering the construction 
of new substations, augmentation of existing substations, additional power transformers, HT lines and 
allied works. 
 
The package includes the supply, testing, transportation, construction, erection, testing and 
commissioning of new substations; augmentation of existing substations; additional power 
transformers; HT lines; and other allied distribution works. It also includes the associated civil works, 
plant and equipment, installation and performance-guarantee responsibilities. 
 
The estimated basic order cost is ₹521.84 crore.  
 
Mr. Ankit Agarwal, CEO & Whole-time Director, RMC Switchgears Limited, said: 
 
“This is a significant opportunity for RMC to demonstrate its end-to-end execution capability on a complex, 
utility-grade distribution-infrastructure programme. The ADR package spans the full project lifecycle - 
from civil works and equipment supply through installation, commissioning and performance assurance - 
and reinforces our ability to deliver integrated electrical EPC solutions at scale. 
 
“The engagement further builds on our experience in Maharashtra and strengthens our credentials in 
high-value distribution infrastructure. We remain focused on disciplined execution, rigorous project 
controls and delivering dependable outcomes for the utility ecosystem.” 
 
The engagement is expected to strengthen RMC’s electrical EPC execution pipeline and expand its 
participation in India’s distribution-network modernisation opportunity. It also builds on the 
Company’s existing experience of distribution infrastructure work in Jalna and Satara. 
 
About RMC Switchgears Limited 
 
RMC Switchgears Limited (NSE: RMC; BSE: 540358) is a Jaipur-based power infrastructure and 
electrical-engineering company with over three decades of experience. The Company delivers 
integrated solutions across electrical products, power-distribution and transmission EPC, solar EPC and 
smart-grid infrastructure, combining manufacturing, engineering, project execution and O&M 
capabilities. Its portfolio includes smart-meter enclosures, feeder pillars, distribution boxes, electrical  
panels and the IS 14772-certified PulseBox™ smart LT distribution box. RMC serves state utilities, 
DISCOMs, PSUs, AMISPs and EPC partners, supporting the modernisation, reliability and sustainability

L&T Wins (Significant*) Order 
for Battery Energy Storage System in Gujarat 
Mumbai, November 25, 2026: Two L&T verticals – the Renewables business and L&T Electronic 
Products & Systems (LTEPS) - have jointly won an order to develop a 300 MW / 900 MWh Battery 
Energy Storage System (BESS) at Khavda in Gujarat.  
The project will feature a three-hour BESS, with a power capacity of 300 MW and an energy 
storage capacity of 900 MWh. By storing surplus renewable energy during periods of high 
generation and releasing it during peak demand, it will help maximise clean-energy utilisation, 
strengthen grid stability, and enhance the flexibility and reliability of power supply. 
The advanced BESS solution will incorporate liquid-cooling technology to deliver higher power 
density, enhanced safety and a longer operating life. The facility will play a crucial role in 
improving grid flexibility and enabling greater integration of renewable energy into India's 
power network. 
The order further strengthens L&T's position in the energy storage sector and reflects the trust 
and confidence that clients place in the Company's ability to deliver complex projects at scale. 
 
 
Background: 
 
Larsen & Toubro is a USD 32 billion Indian multinational engaged in EPC Projects, Hi-Tech Manufacturing, 
Products and Services, operating across diverse domains and multiple geographies. With a strong impetus 
towards AI & technology, customer–focussed approach and the constant quest for top-class quality have 
enabled L&T to attain and sustain leadership in its major lines of business for eight decades.

In pursuance of Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015, SBC Exports Limited (“the Company”) wish to inform you that Work 
Order for providing Manpower supply has been awarded to us by the Institute of Company 
Secretaries of India(ICSI), New Delhi vide Work order number M2610730 . 
 
We are hereby submitting the Additional Details Required under SEBI Circular dated November 
11th, 2024 (SEBI/HO/CFD/CFD-PoD-1/P/CIR/2023/123), under Regulation 30 and 30A of SEBI 
(LODR) Regulations, 2015. - Additional details of Receiving of Order are as under: 
1.  Name of the entity awarding the order(s)/contract(s): Ministry of Electronics and 
Information Technology through NICSI. 
 
2.  Significant terms and conditions of order(s)/contract(s) awarded in brief:  
• This empanelment is for NICSI/NIC internal requirement/Projects and hence 
the selected vendor shall discharge all its obligations under this tender to 
NIC/user departments as the case may be under orders from NICSI.  
 
• The payment to the agency will be made on monthly basis depending upon 
the actual duration of the support services rendered at NICSI/User Office 
after availing service. 
 
• It is bounden duty of the empanelled agency to regularly pay the deployed 
manpower their entitlements like monthly salries/ wages/ annual 
increment/ EPF/ESI/Bonus/Medical Insurance/Accidental Insurance etc. as 
may be applicable and submit the proof thereof to NICSI along with Vendor 
Invoices for the processing of the bills.. 
 
• In the case of Demand Draft submitted as EMD, the Agency can opt for 
converting the same as Security Deposit for the period empanelment plus 
three months. 
 
3.  Whether order(s)/contract(s) have been awarded by domestic/international entity: 
Domestic Entity. 
 

 
4.  Nature of order(s)/contract(s): Order for supply of Manpower.  
 
5.  Time period by which the order(s)/contract(s) is to be executed: Three Month(s).  
 
6.  Date of Allotment of Order: 25 th  November, 2026. 
 
7.  Broad consideration or size of the order(s)/contract(s): INR ₹ 1,23,44,819/- 
(Rupees One crore twenty three lakhs Forty four Thousand Eight Hundred 
Ninteen  only)  
 
8.  Whether the promoter/ promoter group / group companies have any interest in the 
entity that awarded the order(s)/contract(s)?  If yes, nature  of  interest  and 
details thereof: NO, None of the  promoter/ promoter group / group companies 
have any interest in the  entity that awarded the order. 
 
9.  Whether the order(s)/contract(s) would fall within related party transactions? If yes, 
whether the same is done at “arms length”: No, the order(s)/contract(s) would not 
fall within related party transactions. 
 
This is for your information and record. 
 
Kindly take it on your record. 
 
Thanking you. 
 
 
For SBC Exports Limited                                                                                    
 
 
 
 
Hariom Sharma                                                 
Company Secretary and Compliance Officer  
M. No.  A41738

Highway Infrastructure Limited Secures ₹12 Crore Work Order for Development of 
Highway Aerocity Residential Project 
 
 
 
Madhya Pradesh, India 25th November 2026: Highway Infrastructure Limited (HIL), an integrated 
infrastructure platform with established capabilities across Tolling, EPC, and Real Estate, is pleased to announce 
that it has received a Work Order from Sacham Highway Real Estates Private Limited for the development and 
construction of its residential project, “Highway Aerocity,” located at Village Garakhedi, Tehsil Bagli, District 
Dewas, Madhya Pradesh. The Work Order carries an approximate value of Rs. 12.00 crore, plus applicable 
GST, subject to variations depending upon site conditions. 
 
The project involves the development and construction of a residential project spread across the designated land 
parcels at Village Garakhedi, Madhya Pradesh. The scope of work encompasses the development and 
construction activities associated with the Highway Aerocity residential project. 
 
The project is scheduled to be executed over a period of two years. This mandate further strengthens HIL's 
presence in the Real Estate segment and aligns with the Company's strategy of diversifying its business portfolio 
across infrastructure and allied development activities. The project reflects the Company's execution capabilities 
and reinforces its commitment to expanding its presence in the real estate development and construction space. 
 
Speaking on the development, Mr. Arun Kumar Jain, Managing Director, Highway Infrastructure 
Limited said: “We are pleased to have received the Work Order from Sacham Highway Real Estates Private 
Limited for the development and construction of the Highway Aerocity residential project. This project marks 
an important milestone in strengthening our presence in the Real Estate segment and further diversifies our 
business portfolio across infrastructure and allied development activities. With a planned execution period of 
two years, the project provides an opportunity to leverage our established execution capabilities and project 
management expertise in the real estate sector. We remain focused on expanding our business across our core 
segments, pursuing emerging opportunities and creating sustainable long-term value for our stakeholders.” 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
Highway Infrastructure Ltd 
 
57-FA, Scheme No. 94, Pipliyahana Junction, Ring Road, Indore, Madhya Pradesh - 452016 
 
 
About Highway Infrastructure Limited: 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Incorporated in 2006, Highway Infrastructure Limited is an integrated infrastructure company with presence 
across Tollway Collection, EPC and Real Estate. With operations spanning 11 states and 1 Union Territory, the 
Company has established capabilities in Tollway Operations and Infrastructure project execution, supported by 
technology-driven processes and an experienced management team. Under the leadership of Mr. Arun Kumar 
Jain, the Company has built a strong track record across its business verticals and continues to focus on 
expanding its presence in the infrastructure sector. With a growing order book and a healthy project pipeline, 
Highway Infrastructure Limited remains focused on pursuing sustainable growth opportunities across India's 
infrastructure and transportation landscape. 
 
 
For more information, please contact:  
Highway Infrastructure Limited
